data.content_ref: inline:The target asserts a shared three-stage digit-exhaustion mechanism between SRC_006 and SRC_003 and stakes the relation on SRC_003 containing the 189-digit consumption step and the 2→3-digit boundary. But the problem context (07e5ec535396) supplies no evidence that SRC_003 actually uses a digit-exhaustion procedure at all; the target's refutation condition is framed as a check on omissions inside SRC_003, yet the only substantive mechanism data cited (9/180/603, terminal 300) is attributed to SRC_006. Without an independent statement of SRC_003's procedure, the 'shared mechanism' claim reduces to projecting SRC_006's internals onto SRC_003, so the proposed dependence relation is not substantively established by the endpoints as given.
